caption: The video captures a calm, narrow body of water bordered by dry golden reeds in the foreground and brown grassy hills beneath a clear deep-blue sky. A large leafless tree with a thick trunk and sprawling bare branches stands rooted in the middle of the water, its form mirrored on the surface, while faint snow-dusted peaks appear in the left background. The camera holds a fixed position, keeping the tree, horizon and hill silhouettes steady. Across the excerpt the water surface carries a continuous, low-amplitude motion: bright patches of sky reflection and the dark vertical streaks of the tree's reflection shift, break apart and re-form slowly. The reflection of the bare branches wavers with these ripples yet never disappears. The foreground reeds and thin twigs remain essentially still, showing at most the faintest variation. The gentle disturbance of the water persists steadily through the whole visible span.
relations: Low-amplitude ripples on the water continuously distort the tree's reflected vertical streaks and bright sky patches.
The leafless tree's reflection wavers with the ripples yet remains intact throughout the span.
Foreground golden reeds and thin twigs stay essentially still while the water surface moves.
The fixed camera keeps tree, horizon, and hill silhouettes steady as reflections shift.
